function: Learned beam handover, i.e. which beam each user accesses, in multi-beam LEO satellite networks with MODQN; handover and user association act above the physical layer (p. 1, p. 3).
notes: Reason above_phy. p. 1: "we design a beam handover strategy based on the multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) method"; p. 3: "We use the access vector to represent the action", the access vector saying "whether user i is connected with beam (l, v) or not" (p. 2). The learned decision is handover/user association only. The satellite exception does not apply: transmit power is fixed (p. 4, Table I: p = 2W), bandwidth is shared equally among the users of a beam (p. 2, Eq. 3), and the spot beams are fixed, their locations being part of the state (p. 2), so no power, resource, or beam control is learned. Borderline for the reviewer: if beam handover is read as beam control, the work would be area 6. Page 1 holds the title and DOI 10.1109/LCOMM.2024.3470890, matching the work.
